verdict.rationale: Unity does serve a site-root llms.txt at unity.com and docs.unity.com has a documentation-wide llms.txt index, so an agent can be pointed at machine-readable docs; the CLI also ships its own llms.txt. However, the primary technical reference (docs.unity3d.com/Manual) returns 404 for llms.txt and has no .md mirrors, meaning the bulk of authoritative Unity documentation is not agent-readable. missing for 10: llms.txt coverage on the core Manual/API reference docs, consistent machine-readable format across all doc subdomains, independent confirmation that agents successfully consume these llms.txt files.
